item.kronwerke.stone_gearbox.tooltip: The first piece of the Kronwerk: andesite, water power and a touch of aura.
item.kronwerke.source_keystone.tooltip: Source, mana and aura bound in one stone.
item.kronwerke.brass_heart.tooltip: Beats to the rhythm of precision mechanisms.
item.kronwerke.rune_core.tooltip: The four elements in one sphere, held by brass.
item.kronwerke.steel_core.tooltip: Circuits, steel and a trace of elven metal.
item.kronwerke.elven_star.tooltip: From Alfheim, bound with afrit essence.
power.kronwerke.kronbuerger_gemeinsinn.d: While another player is within 16 blocks and you are out of combat, you get Regeneration I. Wounds heal better together.
power.kronwerke.kronbuerger_anpacker.des: You get hungry 15 percent slower. Work is your everyday life, not a strain.
power.kronwerke.kronbuerger_heimweh.name: Homesick
power.kronwerke.kronbuerger_heimweh.desc: Outside the Overworld you miss home: in the Nether, the End and every other dimension you get hungry 30 percent faster.
origins.kronwerke.kronbuerger.name: Crown Citizen
origins.kronwerke.kronbuerger.descriptio: You grew up in the town around the obelisk, among market stalls, scaffolding and people who always need a hand. Nothing fancy, but you pitch in everywhere and you are at your best among friends. The right pick for your first time in Kronwerke.
power.kronwerke.muehlenkind_flussatem.de: You hold your breath much longer than others, about three times as long.
power.kronwerke.muehlenkind_nasse_haende: Under water you break blocks as fast as on land. Perfect for water wheels, locks and foundations in the river.
power.kronwerke.muehlenkind_trockene_keh: One heart less. You were built for water, not for fighting.
origins.kronwerke.muehlenkind.name: Millchild
origins.kronwerke.muehlenkind.descriptio: You grew up by the river under the water wheels of the Steinwerk and spent more time in the millstream than in bed. Under water you are in your element, but hot and dry lands wear you down. Easy to play and perfect for anyone who likes to build by the water.
power.kronwerke.tiefgraeber_stollenaugen: You see in the dark as if it were day. Toggle it with the Night Vision key (default K).
power.kronwerke.tiefgraeber_hauerhand.de: Everything mined with a pickaxe breaks 25 percent faster for you. You get no extra ore, you just get there sooner.
power.kronwerke.tiefgraeber_heimat_unter: In the mining world you have Haste I at all times.
power.kronwerke.tiefgraeber_lichtscheu.d: In daylight under open sky you take 50 percent more damage. At night, under a roof and underground you are yourself.
origins.kronwerke.tiefgraeber.name: Deepdigger
origins.kronwerke.tiefgraeber.descriptio: Your family has lived in the tunnels of the mining world for generations. You see in the dark, your pickaxe knows every stone and underground is home. On the surface the sun blinds you and daylight makes you weak.
power.kronwerke.messingblut_hitzefest.de: Fire, lava and anything burning deals only half damage to you.
power.kronwerke.messingblut_schmiedeglut: Near a furnace, blaze burner or campfire (5 blocks) you have Haste I.
origins.kronwerke.messingblut.name: Brassblood
origins.kronwerke.messingblut.descriptio: You were born in the forges of the Messingwerk, among blaze burners and glowing ingots. Heat barely bothers you and at the furnace your hands work on their own. Water and rain, however, make you stiff as old brass. When the Nether opens, you are the first pick for the blaze hunt.
power.kronwerke.aurakind_waldatem.name: Forest Breath
power.kronwerke.aurakind_waldatem.descri: In forest, taiga and jungle you heal half a heart every 4 seconds.
power.kronwerke.aurakind_naturglueck.des: You have +1 Luck. Fishing and chests turn up good things more often.
power.kronwerke.aurakind_fern_der_wurzel: In the Nether and the End you take 50 percent more damage. Go there with friends, not alone.
origins.kronwerke.aurakind.name: Aurachild
origins.kronwerke.aurakind.description: You grew up next to a natural altar and its aura shaped you. In the forest you heal on your own, poison runs off you and nature's luck is on your side. Far from anything that grows, in the Nether and the End, you turn weak and tired.
power.kronwerke.quellgeborene_tiefe_quel: You have 50 extra mana for Ars Nouveau.
power.kronwerke.quellgeborene_zaubersinn: You have 50 extra mana for Iron's Spells.
power.kronwerke.quellgeborene_kein_eisen: You cannot wear iron, gold, diamond or netherite armor. Leather, chainmail and mage robes are fine.
origins.kronwerke.quellgeborene.name: Sourceborn
origins.kronwerke.quellgeborene.descript: You were born at a source, where the magic of Ars Nouveau seeps out of the ground. Your mana reaches further than other mages', in Ars Nouveau as well as in Iron's Spells. In exchange your body is frail and cannot bear heavy metal armor.
power.kronwerke.runentraeger_runenhaut.d: You have 2 points of natural armor.
power.kronwerke.runentraeger_bannzeichen: Magic damage hits you 30 percent weaker, for example from potions, witches and thorns.
power.kronwerke.runentraeger_standfest.d: Knockback throws you 25 percent less far.
power.kronwerke.runentraeger_schwere_zei: You fall like a stone: double fall damage. Build stairs, do not jump.
origins.kronwerke.runentraeger.name: Runebearer
origins.kronwerke.runentraeger.descripti: The old runes of the obelisk are burned into your skin. They harden you like stone and keep foreign magic away, but they weigh heavy. You are the rock others hide behind in a boss fight.
power.kronwerke.sternensplitter_sternens: With your ability key you leap to the block you look at, up to 16 blocks away. It costs a little hunger and recharges for 10 seconds. It does not pass through walls.
Fall damage is halved for you.
power.kronwerke.sternensplitter_endblick: Endermen do not get angry when you look at them.
origins.kronwerke.sternensplitter.name: Starshard
origins.kronwerke.sternensplitter.descri: You carry a shard of the Sternwerk inside you, a piece of the light beyond the End. You leap short distances through space, fall softly, and endermen take you for one of their own. But your body of stardust endures less than others'.
power.kronwerke.chaosgezeichnete_chaosfu: Your attacks deal one heart more damage.
power.kronwerke.chaosgezeichnete_zehrend: Every time you kill a creature you heal one heart.
Monsters smell the chaos in you and hunt you from 32 blocks away, even without seeing you.
origins.kronwerke.chaosgezeichnete.name: Chaosmarked
origins.kronwerke.chaosgezeichnete.descr: Since birth you carry a mark that matches the chaos waiting at the end of all stages. You hit harder and draw strength from every foe you fell. But the chaos gnaws at you: your wounds close only half as fast.
power.kronwerke.rolle_ingenieur_werkzeug: You start with a Create wrench.
power.kronwerke.rolle_ingenieur_zahnradm: When you craft cogwheels by hand you get one extra.
power.kronwerke.rolle_ingenieur_arbeitss: Damage from Create machines such as crushing wheels, saws, drills, rollers, trains and fans is halved for you.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_ingenieur.name: Engineer
origins.kronwerke.rolle_ingenieur.descri: You build the machines that work for everyone while they sleep. Water wheels, presses, mixers and later the precision mechanism: without you the tech pillar at the obelisk will not fill.
power.kronwerke.rolle_arkanist_quellschu: Your Ars Nouveau mana regenerates 1 per second faster.
power.kronwerke.rolle_arkanist_trankkund: Potions last 25 percent longer on you.
power.kronwerke.rolle_arkanist_zauberbuc: You start with an Ars Nouveau novice spell book.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_arkanist.name: Arcanist
origins.kronwerke.rolle_arkanist.descrip: You keep the magic pillar running: source gems, mana pearls and runes do not fall from the sky. Your source recovers faster and your potions last longer.
power.kronwerke.rolle_baumeister_steinbr: You break stone, deepslate, granite, diorite, andesite and tuff 30 percent faster.
power.kronwerke.rolle_baumeister_weiter_: You reach blocks from 1.5 blocks further away.
power.kronwerke.rolle_baumeister_schwind: Who lives on scaffolding learns to fall: fall damage is 40 percent lower for you.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_baumeister.name: Builder
origins.kronwerke.rolle_baumeister.descr: You build the town around the obelisk and break stone after stone for it. Twenty thousand cobblestone for the foundation of the Kronwerk? You just laugh and grab your pickaxe.
You start with a Nature's Compass that points you to any biome.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_entdecker.name: Explorer
origins.kronwerke.rolle_entdecker.descri: You head out while others are still building. Biomes, structures, waystones and the resources missing near town: you find them and bring the map home.
power.kronwerke.rolle_hueter_totenbann.d: Undead you hit get Weakness I for 4 seconds.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_hueter.name: Keeper
origins.kronwerke.rolle_hueter.descripti: You stand in front when it gets dangerous: at Afrit rituals, at the dragon, against Gaia and in the end against the Chaos Guardian. For that you are tougher than the rest.
power.kronwerke.rolle_versorger_viehzuch: When you breed animals there is a 30 percent chance of a second baby.
power.kronwerke.rolle_versorger_gute_kue: Food you craft or take out of a furnace or smoker yourself fills more hunger and keeps you full for longer.
power.kronwerke.rolle_versorger_eiserner: The Hunger and Nausea effects cannot touch you. You taste everything, after all.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_versorger.name: Provider
origins.kronwerke.rolle_versorger.descri: No factory runs on empty stomachs. You keep the animals, cook for everyone and make sure nobody stands at the obelisk with a growling belly.
power.kronwerke.rolle_haendler_feilschen: You pay about 15 percent less at villagers.
power.kronwerke.rolle_haendler_packtasch: You have nine extra inventory slots, opened with your ability key. If you die, the contents drop.
origins.kronwerke.rolle_haendler.name: Trader
origins.kronwerke.rolle_haendler.descrip: You know who has what and who needs what. You haggle with villagers, haul goods through town and always have one more free spot in your bag.
power.kronwerke.muehlenkind_zunder.name: Tinder
power.kronwerke.muehlenkind_zunder.descr: Fire and lava deal double damage to you. A millchild does not belong at the blast furnace.
power.kronwerke.tiefgraeber_tiefenschlag: Deepslate and tuff break in one hit, the ores in them too.
power.kronwerke.messingblut_leitfaehig.d: Brass conducts: magic, spells and lightning deal double damage to you.
power.kronwerke.messingblut_schwer.name: Heavy Blood
power.kronwerke.messingblut_schwer.descr: One heart less. Brass is tough, but not alive.
